comment: Which Notion pages are derived from this repository, and what they are derived from. Gate G15 compares the hash below against the working tree, so drift is caught without network access. `pending: true` means the page has never been machine-published and the gate reports it without failing. `changelogDatabase` is the Notion database the pusher appends a row to after a successful push, so machine-driven changes record themselves. See docs/notion-workspace.md section 9 and ADR 0021.

mirrors.title: Architecture diagrams
mirrors.why: Engineer-facing diagrams, published so nobody has to clone a repository to see the shape of the system. No human writes on this page.

diagrams.section: ### Principals (A6, decided — ADR 0003; a fourth kind added by ADR 0035)

mirrors.title: Domain model and vocabulary: state machines
mirrors.why: The lead and deal state machines are the same graph for both audiences, so there is nothing to simplify. The rest of that page, including the simplified ERD and the vocabulary table, is editorial and the pusher never touches it.

mirrors.title: How the system fits together
mirrors.why: A rewrite for a non-engineering reader: the context diagram is redrawn around people rather than processes, and the invariants become three plain-language properties. Cannot be generated from the source.

mirrors.title: Domain model and vocabulary: ERD and words
mirrors.why: The published ERD is a deliberate subset of the real one: no api_client, no outbox_event, no provider_event, because those answer engineering questions and would only confuse the vocabulary conversation.

mirrors.title: What we are building
mirrors.why: Stakeholder-readable mirror of the scope. Reordered around what a person can do rather than around product areas.

sources.section: ## 20. Out of Scope for Initial MVP

mirrors.title: Deck vs reality
mirrors.why: The ten divergences between what the pitch deck promises and what the first release ships. The single most expensive page to let go stale, because a stakeholder who reads only the deck holds expectations the release will not meet.

mirrors.title: Open product questions
mirrors.why: Mirror of the open questions, phrased for the people who can answer them rather than for the engineer who raised them.
